stemMd: An event sold 80 tickets, some at 9 units and the rest at 6 units, for total revenue 570 units. How many tickets were sold at 9 units?
explanationMd: If all 80 cost 6, revenue would be 480. Each higher-price ticket adds 3 units, and the excess is 90, so 90/3=30 tickets cost 9.
